answer: Yes, this is a real bug. Root cause: sim/simulator.go executeBatchStep() increments TotalOutputTokens on every decode step (line 647), but when a request is preempted in batch_formation.go preemptForTokens() (line 232), ProgressIndex is reset to 0 while TotalOutputTokens is never decremented. When the request is rescheduled, it re-prefills and re-decodes from scratch, double-counting all previously generated output tokens. With 265 preemptions, this inflated total_output_tokens from 105082 to 114630 (9% inflation). The fix moves TotalOutputTokens counting from per-step to completion time (using len(req.ITL) which tracks actual decode steps), clears req.ITL on preemption to prevent ITL accumulation, and reverses TTFTSum contributions on preemption to prevent TTFT double-counting.
